description: Single-VM scenario delivering the Rocket.Chat docker-compose stack (mongodb + mongo-init-replica + rocketchat + provisioner) on admin-rocketchat-standalone (VMID 1185, IP 192.168.142.185, vmbr142) via the shared bundle bundles/admin/software.install.rocketchat/, against the catalog element range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/rocketchat/. Rocket.Chat is modeled as an admin-tier service gated by INSTALL_ROCKETCHAT (default YES - rocketchat_lab is the Rocket.Chat showcase scenario). The stack uses a MongoDB replica-set ; cold-start convergence takes ~90-180s on first deploy. Template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) is built by this scenario's 01_templates-bootstrap/ (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario such as blank_scenario_2_subnets, demo_lab, misp_lab, or nextcloud_lab).
